slides.title: Class Templates Concept
slides.prompt: Class templates allow creating generic blueprints for classes (e.g., containers). Methods defined outside the class body require separate template parameter declarations.

slides.title: Class Template Instantiation Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the type argument specifier required when instantiating a class template prior to C++17.

slides.title: Class Template Method Definition Outside
slides.prompt: Which syntax is required when defining a class template member function outside the class body?
options: Prefix definition with 'template <typename T>' and qualify class name as 'ClassName<T>::'
Qualify function name with inline keyword only
Class template methods can only be defined inline inside class body
slides.correctAnswer: Prefix definition with 'template <typename T>' and qualify class name as 'ClassName<T>::'

slides.title: Member Template Functions
slides.prompt: Fill in the template parameter name for an independent template method inside a class template.

slides.title: Class Template Deduction Guides (CTAD)
slides.prompt: What feature introduced in C++17 allows writing 'std::pair p(1, 2.5);' without explicit type parameters?

slides.title: Friend Templates Syntax
slides.prompt: To grant a template function access to private members, declare it as a ___ template.
slides.codeSnippet:
template <typename U>
___ void display(const Box<U>& b);

slides.title: Virtual Member Function Templates Restriction
slides.prompt: Why can a member function template NOT be declared virtual in C++?
options: VTable size must be fixed at compile-time; unlimited template instantiations would make fixed VTables impossible
Templates cannot be used inside class definitions
Virtual functions do not support parameter passing
Compilers restrict virtual keyword to static methods
slides.correctAnswer: VTable size must be fixed at compile-time; unlimited template instantiations would make fixed VTables impossible

slides.title: Template Class Inheritance
slides.prompt: Fill in the qualification required when inheriting from a class template dependent base class.

slides.title: Class Template Static Members
slides.prompt: How are static member variables shared across instances of a Class Template?
options: Each distinct template instantiation type (e.g., Box<int> vs Box<double>) gets its own separate static variable
All instantiations share a single global static variable across all types
Static variables are forbidden inside class templates
Static members are re-initialized on every object construction
slides.correctAnswer: Each distinct template instantiation type (e.g., Box<int> vs Box<double>) gets its own separate static variable
